theme_central: From the Night Journey to the fundamental ethical commandments: the surah links the Prophet's highest spiritual experience to the most concrete moral demands of everyday life.
sources_note: The block of ethical commandments (22-39) precisely sourced (islampak.com / zamzamacademy.com). The rest reconstructed from well-established landmarks (Night Journey v.1, the question about the spirit v.85, the challenge of the Qur'an v.88-89).

branches.title: The Night Journey, the Children of Israel
branches.resume: The Night Journey (Isra) to al-Aqsa Mosque; the prophecy of the two corruptions of the Children of Israel.

children.t: The Night Journey from the Sacred Mosque to al-Aqsa Mosque
The Book given to Musa, the prophecy of the two corruptions of the Children of Israel

branches.title: The Qur'an as guide, the hasty man
branches.resume: The Qur'an guides to what is most upright; each acts according to his own disposition; contrast between this world and the next.

children.t: The Qur'an guides to what is most upright, each person bears the weight of their own deeds
Fate of destroyed cities, contrast between those who want this world and those who want the next

branches.title: The ethical commandments
branches.resume: A famous block: exclusive worship, kindness to parents, the rights of relatives, against waste, infanticide, adultery, injustice, the orphan, fair measure, arrogance.

children.t: Worshipping Allah alone, kindness to parents
Rights of relatives and the needy, prohibition of waste
Prohibition of killing children, adultery, unjust killing
The orphan's property, fair measure and weight, not walking the earth arrogantly

branches.title: Refutation, Iblis, supplication
branches.resume: Refutation of attributing daughters to Allah, the account of Iblis refusing to bow before Adam.

children.t: Refutation of attributing daughters to Allah, the resurrection reaffirmed
Saying what is best, the Qur'an as a warning
Iblis refuses to bow before Adam, his limited power over the sincere

branches.title: Blessings, Judgment, prayer
branches.resume: Blessings of land and sea transport, the scene of Judgment, the establishment of prayer.

children.t: Blessings of transport; every group called with its book at the Judgment
Attempt to divert the Prophet from the revelation
Establishment of prayer, the supererogatory night prayer, the Qur'an as healing

branches.title: The spirit, the challenge of the Qur'an
branches.resume: The question about the spirit (ruh), the challenge to produce a similar book, a brief reminder of Musa and Pharaoh.

children.t: The question about the spirit; challenge: men and jinn could not produce a similar Qur'an
Unreasonable demands of the disbelievers, what prevents people from believing
Musa and Pharaoh, the nine clear signs

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: The Qur'an revealed in truth, those who weep upon hearing it, final praise.

children.t: The Qur'an revealed in truth, final praise to Allah, Great above any associate
